title: sparganium emersum subsp. acaule
intro: Sparganium emersum subsp. acaule, commonly known as the floating bur-reed, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Sparganiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including relief from inflammation, pain, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Sparganium emersum subsp. acaule include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
